keyVerseDR: "...say the word, and my servant shall be healed." (Lk 7:7)

level1.title: Just Say the Word
level1.story: A Roman officer's servant was very sick. He sent word to Jesus: "Just say the word, and he will be healed." Jesus was amazed at his faith, and the servant was healed.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What words do we say like him at Mass?
level1.prayer: Jesus, only say the word. Amen.

activity.title: Lord, I am not worthy
activity.intro: We pray like the centurion at Mass. Trace his words.
activity.text: Say the word, and my servant shall be healed.

level2.title: The Centurion's Faith
level2.story: A centurion had a servant who was sick and ready to die. He sent elders to ask Jesus to come and heal him. As Jesus came near, the centurion sent friends saying, "Lord, trouble not Thyself; for I am not worthy that Thou shouldst enter under my roof." He said, "Say the word, and my servant shall be healed." Jesus marveled and said, "I have not found so great faith, not even in Israel," and the servant was healed.
level2.keyLine: Say the word, and my servant shall be healed.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Where do we hear the centurion's words at Mass?
How can you pray for others with faith?
actions: Pray the 'Lord, I am not worthy' with attention
level2.prayer: Lord, I am not worthy, but only say the word. Amen.

activity.title: We say it at Mass
activity.intro: Read it, fold one line at a time, and say it from memory.
activity.question: What did the centurion say to Jesus?
activity.answer: Lord, I am not worthy that Thou shouldst enter under my roof... but say the word, and my servant shall be healed.

art.mainBrief: Roman centurion humbly sending a message to Jesus
